notes: Access: tier1 HTTP (curl_cffi, iOS Safari + Chrome impersonation) reached robots.txt and the site's XML sitemap index/category sitemap fine, but every product-listing page fetch returned Akamai's soft-block ('Something went wrong', HTTP 200) - matches the prior Furniture-pass note about Akamai gating this host. Tier2 Playwright headless Chromium hit the identical site-wide soft-block. Tier3 Claude-in-Chrome (shared session, heavily contended by 9 other concurrent workers) got a bot-protection interstitial on the first attempt, then succeeded on a fresh tab after the tab-group churned, returning real rendered content. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only generic paths incl. /us/store/search/ and *?*Ntt= query search - avoided per that disallow). Navigation discovery: downloaded and grep'd the full categorySiteMap.xml (838KB, every category x refinement combination on the site) for best-sell, bestsell, best_sell, top-sell, popular, favorite/customer-favorite, trending, hot-right-now, must-have, editor, shop-the-look, fan-favorite - zero genuine Bestsellers/Top-Sellers/Popular/Customer-Favorites nodes anywhere on the site (not just Home). This is a strong absence check because the same sitemap DOES mirror 'New Arrivals' (refinement node N-842114098) and 'Clearance' (refinement node N-3951437597) crossed with every single category node including Home - if a Bestsellers refinement existed it would show up the same way. Also loaded the Marshalls homepage (www.marshalls.com/us/store/index.jsp) via Claude-in-Chrome and read its main nav: Women / Shoes / Men / Accessories / Kids & Baby / Home / New Arrivals - no Bestsellers/Top Sellers/Popular link. The homepage does show a 'Have You Heard? These Are Trending...' carousel, but it is a homepage-only curated apparel carousel (track pants, jackets, boots, handbags - no Home/decor products) with no product-count header, not a PLP, and not Home-specific - it maps to the sitemap's fashion-only 'trending-now' collection nodes (checked trending-now+home combinations specifically: none exist). Site search was not used (robots.txt disallow on /us/store/search/); the taxonomy-sitemap sweep is a stronger absence check regardless. Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers-type PLP exists for Marshalls Home.
